attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a router between lan-a (node2, 10.50.1.0/24) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.2.0/24) using pure routing plus stateful forward-filter firewall rules, with no NAT, so node2 and node3 reach each other on any port with original source addresses preserved. Added static routes on node2/node3 pointing at node1, and relaxed each host's local firewalld zone on the LAN NIC (it was blocking non-SSH ports, unrelated to node1's routing) so arbitrary-port TCP could be exercised end-to-end. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-id changes and post-restart functional recovery.
